scenes.headline: Escape the False Choice of Career Risk
bullets: Timid stagnation and reckless leaps both fail builders
Smart operators separate survival cashflow from asymmetric upside
scenes.narration: Conventional career advice offers two bad choices: play it completely safe forever, or burn your boats on one reckless leap.

scenes.headline: Nassim Taleb's Antifragile System
scenes.stat_label: SKIP FRAGILE 'MODERATE RISK' IN THE MIDDLE
bullets: Middle-of-the-road bets often hide catastrophic downside
Weighting both extremes protects survival while inviting breakouts
scenes.narration: Risk scholar Nassim Taleb outlined a smarter third system in Antifragile called the Barbell Strategy. Skip fragile moderate risk in the middle, and deliberately weight the two extremes.

scenes.headline: Reckless Leap vs 90/10 Barbell Split
scenes.left_body: Quit paycheck early -> rent stress forces short-term panic
scenes.right_body: 90% stable cashflow & reserves + 10% weekly digital assets
scenes.narration: Put ninety percent of your foundation on ironclad defense: steady career cashflow, low fixed overhead, and liquid reserves. Put ten percent, five focused hours a week, into uncapped digital bets.
scenes.source: Nassim Nicholas Taleb, Antifragile (2012); 90/10 split and hours are a Mind & Margin rule of thumb

scenes.headline: Capped Downside, Uncapped Weekly Shots
scenes.stat_label: 52 ASYMMETRIC SHOTS PER YEAR AT ZERO RUIN
scenes.stat_subtext: Worst case: lose 5 hours • Best case: compounding asset
scenes.narration: Use the Barbell Rule: never risk stability you need to sleep calmly at night, and never let a week pass without shipping one small project with uncapped upside.

scenes.headline: Calm Floors Create Unstoppable Patience
bullets: Keep fixed bills low and primary income rock-solid
Compound 1 digital brick every Saturday for 52 weeks
scenes.narration: When your downside is protected, patience turns asymmetric bets into inevitable wins.
scenes.source: Mind & Margin rule of thumb (advice, not a study)
